hints.title: Row Bitmask Formulation
hints.text: Represent each row of the matrix as a binary integer mask where the j-th bit is 1 if matrix[i][j] equals 1.

hints.title: Column Combination Enumeration
hints.text: Since the number of columns is small (at most 12), enumerate all possible combinations of numSelect chosen columns.

hints.title: Covered Row Condition
hints.text: A row is covered by the chosen column mask if all 1s in the row are included in the chosen mask (that is, (row_mask & ~chosen_mask) equals 0).

hints.title: Bitmask Column Combination Selection Implementation

complexity.notes: Small n <= 12 yields at most C(12, 6) = 924 subset evaluations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Unpruned exponential search over arbitrary cells fails to leverage column-wise uniformity.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Row masks compress row comparisons into single bitwise operations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Compresses rows into bitmasks and explores column combinations with bitwise containment.
